verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only fixed telephony features: auto attendant menus for routing callers, ring-group round-robin, and automatic call recording on higher tiers. These are adjacent call-handling behaviors, not user-defined automations or background workflows, and nothing documents a rules engine, triggers, scheduled tasks or agentic automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
